rhythm: Equal nominal durations are a draft, not proof of natural movement. Compare all four transition errors divided by duration; inspect the actual loop in ChatGPT.
sourceRule: One independent PNG per frame. No full-sheet generation, chained redraw, camera move or global bounce.
